description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `GovPool.deposit(amount, nftIds)` — stakes into the DAO to gain voting power. Payable: native-coin DAOs pass `value`; ERC20 DAOs pass value=0 and need the GovUserKeeper approve first.

amount.description: Governance token to stake, in that token's own decimals. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

nftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

value.description: Native coin (BNB/ETH, 18 decimals) sent with the tx — native-staking DAOs only. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create. Pass '0' for ERC20-staking DAOs

name: dexe_vote_build_deposit
title: Stake tokens/NFTs into a DAO to gain voting power
